# 有冇 + Noun？ · *jau5 mou5 + Noun?*

**Meaning:** Is there…? / Do you have…? · **Level:** A1 · **Topic:** Asking questions

> ⚠️ **Draft — awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [open an issue](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new).

有冇 ('have or not have') turns 有 into a question. Answer 有 for yes or 冇 for no. Ending with 呀 makes it sound friendly.

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **有冇奶茶呀？** |
| Jyutping | jau5 mou5 naai5 caa4 aa3? |
| Yale | yáuh móuh náaih chàh a? |
| Bopomofo | ㄧㄜㄨ⁵ ㄇㄛㄨ⁵ ㄋㄚㄧ⁵ ㄘㄚ⁴ ㄚ³? |
| English | Do you have milk tea? |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **你有冇八達通呀？** |
| Jyutping | nei5 jau5 mou5 baat3 daat6 tung1 aa3? |
| Yale | néih yáuh móuh baat daaht tūng a? |
| Bopomofo | ㄋㄝㄧ⁵ ㄧㄜㄨ⁵ ㄇㄛㄨ⁵ ㄅㄚㆵ³ ㄉㄚㆵ⁶ ㄊㄨㄥ¹ ㄚ³? |
| English | Do you have an Octopus card? |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **附近有冇銀行呀？** |
| Jyutping | fu6 gan6 jau5 mou5 ngan4 hong4 aa3? |
| Yale | fuh gahn yáuh móuh ngàhn hòhng a? |
| Bopomofo | ㄈㄨ⁶ ㄍㄜㄣ⁶ ㄧㄜㄨ⁵ ㄇㄛㄨ⁵ ㆭㄜㄣ⁴ ㄏㄛㄥ⁴ ㄚ³? |
| English | Is there a bank nearby? |
